comparisons.publicTruth: Let's get dirty again. 😈 Chrome Cologne is a place for music, creativity, and freedom. At its core is an immersive hard techno experience where people come together to dance, express themselves, and enjoy the moment. As a sex-positive event, Chrome Cologne also offers an optional playroom. Participation is entirely voluntary. No one is expected or pressured to take part. The dancefloor remains the heart of the event. Awareness Comes First Creating a respectful and as safe as possible environment for all guests is our highest priority. Our Awareness Team is present throughout the entire event and can be easily identified by their printed Awareness shirts and blue LED lights. In addition, there is an Awareness Point located at the entrance of the playroom, where a team member will always be available to assist you. If you feel uncomfortable, experience harassment, or need help for any reason, please speak to us at any time. If you notice someone who may need support, we appreciate you informing our team as well. In addition to the Awareness Team, you can also approach the bar staff, cloakroom staff, or security personnel. Playroom Rules The playroom is a protected space for consensual encounters. The following rules apply without exception: Consent is key. Only a clear "yes" means yes. Always ask before observing, touching, or joining others. Respect personal boundaries without discussion. Treat all guests with respect and discretion. No drinks are allowed inside the playroom. Violations of these rules will be addressed consistently by our team.
